name: Balistic Kask
description: One of the most common pieces of Pre-War soldier equipment, this cheaply mass-produced helmet is sturdy enough against bludgeon attacks, but will not stop a bullet.

name: Ekzoskelet Legs
description: A Mechanist's bizarre invention, the Ekzoskelet Legs are a heavy-duty lining of metal parts woven together with regular trousers. They're designed to offer great resistance and to actually improve the wearer's stamina, but they're still very clumsy to use.

name: GP-4 Gas Mask
description: This widespread Gas Mask was issued to Civil Defense and civilians alike, during the times of War. Vultures and Bandits often wear these for days at a time, and the mask’s straps dig themselves painfully into the back of their heads.

name: Old Tactical Vest
description:
A beat-up tactical vest worn by police forces of pre-Mist times. It offers great mobility and decent protection against weaker types of weapon fire.

This vest is usually a reward for those with basic training and experience in the field.
source_note: Direct in-game tooltip at 100% durability. Displayed approximate value recorded as price; vendor sale price and unlock rank are not shown.

name: Panskiy Kask
description: An old aviator's helmet, with stellar wind protection and decent resistance against impact. However, it's a bit uncomfortable to wear all day long, and it dulls the senses a bit - not ideal for the field.

name: Skull Mask
description: A menacing mask in the shape of a skull, worn by different folks for different reasons: some in respect and awe of the dead, others in order to intimidate and scare.

name: Stronghold Vest
description:
A souped-up tactical vest, with shoulder guards and bits of metal woven in throughout the fabric. Offers good protection from weaker weapons, at the cost of mobility.

This combat-oriented vest is usually worn by those have proven themselves capable.

name: Old Tactical Pants
description: A pair of beat-up tactical pants worn by the armed men of pre-War times. Offers great mobility and is pretty comfortable, but doesn't protect against the rocky terrain of the wastes.
source_note: Direct in-game tooltip at 100% durability. Displayed approximate value recorded as price; vendor sale price and unlock rank are not shown.
